verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hostable on your own servers and databases (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL and others), with admin-panel configuration, so the operator has custody of all data and can decide how long to keep it. However, the evidence never documents any retention-policy or deletion features, and one community report says backup and restore remains weak. missing for 10: documented retention policies, user/admin data deletion controls (account, repo, artifact or log purging), configurable cleanup schedules, independent corroboration.
